purpose: Teach: 椎/蕾/唾/皺/両端/左折/８つ/スギ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが椎茸の食べ方を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught me how to prepare shiitake mushrooms.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Gentle smile underneath. Speaking to Sho as though sharing a small gift of a memory. Unhurried, slightly dreamy—recalling something kind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと桜の蕾を毎日観察してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watch the cherry blossoms every single day.
lines.style: Bright, earnest energy. Quick-paced, eager to share. Small voice but completely unselfconscious. Pride in the routine, not in being noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「歌う時に唾を飛ばさない様にね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me, 'Be careful not to spray when you sing,' remember?
lines.style: Gently amused, affectionate. Light lilt of memory. Speaking as though Sho will recognize the tender instruction. Soft, intimate register—she's remembering his kindness out loud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに服の皺を伸ばす道具を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me how to use the iron to smooth out wrinkles.
lines.style: Sincere, pleased. Steady pace—he's genuinely proud of learning something practical. Small but certain voice. No performance, just fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが本棚の両端の本を整えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad straightened all the books on both ends of the shelf for me.
lines.style: Tender, quiet gratitude in the voice. Unhurried. Speaking as if describing something both small and important. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに公園の入り口で左折って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad showed me to turn left when we get to the park entrance.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. The pride of being instructed, of holding directions in his head. Earnest, direct—no embellishment, just grateful fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお弁当のおかずを８つ用意して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad prepared eight different side dishes for the lunch box.
lines.style: Quiet marvel at the care. Slow, deliberate pacing—letting the number breathe. Tender admiration. Speaking as if witnessing an act of love.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんがスギの香りのお風呂、つまり檜湯を準備して下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad got the cypress bath ready for me—that citrus-cedar smell.
lines.style: Warm delight, present-moment brightness. Quick but grounded. Speaking as though the scent is still there. Genuine gratitude, unselfconsciously pleased.
